tools.name: draw
tools.description: Draw a chemical structure or reaction as a publication-style figure (ChemDraw-like skeletal formula) with the Lone Pair editor's renderer. Give SMILES, reaction SMILES, InChI, a molfile, a ChemDraw file, or a compound name with name=true. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES th

tools.name: render_reaction
tools.description: Draw a reaction scheme from its parts: reactants joined by plus signs, an arrow with optional text above and below, then products. Each structure is SMILES, InChI or a molfile. For a reaction already written as reaction SMILES, use draw. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES tha

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a structure between formats: cdxml, cdx, mol, molV3, sdf, rxn, rxnV3, smiles, inchi, inchikey, cml, mrv, json (mol = V2000 molfile, molV3 = V3000, json = Lone Pair drawing). Reads ChemDraw CDXML and CDX. `notes` says what the target format cannot keep (for example dative bonds in a V2000 mol

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: For each structure in the input: molecular formula, molecular weight, exact (monoisotopic) mass, elemental analysis, SMILES, InChI and InChIKey. For a reaction: each structure's role and whether atoms and charge balance (each drawn structure counted once). Calculated from the structure, not looked u

tools.name: edit_drawing
tools.description: Change a figure Lone Pair made earlier and get the new figure: add a structure to the right of it, change the journal style, or put a caption under it. Give the earlier result's `drawing`. Everything else in the drawing stays as it was. Moving or deleting atoms is not supported; draw the structure a

tools.name: estimate_pka
tools.description: Estimate the pKa of each acidic site (the X–H, in water and in DMSO where tabulated) and the pKaH of each basic site of a structure, most acidic first, with the basis of each value. These are the same rule-based estimates as the Lone Pair editor's pKa tool: tabulated values (Evans–Ripin, Bordwell/Re

tools.name: estimate_bde
tools.description: Estimate homolytic bond dissociation energies (gas phase, 298 K) in kcal/mol and kJ/mol, weakest bond first, with the basis of each value. By default every X–H bond and every acyclic single bond between heavy atoms. These are the same estimates as the Lone Pair editor's BDE tool: Blanksby & Ellison

tools.name: verify_figure
tools.description: Check a finished figure (SVG, or HTML with inline SVG) that holds structures Lone Pair drew with embed: true. tools.name: compose_figure
tools.description: Put Lone Pair structures over a picture, such as a background an image model made with empty space for each molecule, so that no structure is drawn by the image model. Give the picture's size in pixels and, for each molecule, its structure and a box (x, y, width, height in the picture's pixels). Eac

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "For each structure in the input: molecular formula, molecular weight, exact (monoisotopic) mass, elemental analysis, SMILES, InChI and InChIKey. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
